title-group.article-title: TL1A (TNFSF15) blockade attenuates intestinal fibrosis in experimental colitis

license.license-p: This article is distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License.

abstract.p: TL1A, encoded by TNFSF15, is a TNF-family cytokine implicated in IBD-associated fibrosis. We tested anti-TL1A therapy in a murine chronic colitis model.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Intestinal fibrosis is a major complication of inflammatory bowel disease driven in part by TL1A-DR3 signaling.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: Mice received a neutralizing anti-TL1A antibody or isotype control during chronic dextran sulfate sodium exposure.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Anti-TL1A treatment reduced collagen deposition and downregulated fibrotic gene expression compared with control.
